# KMAN Publication Inc. Journals

> A peer-reviewed academic publishing platform specializing in open-access journals across psychology, counseling, health sciences, sports, and organizational research.

KMANPUB is an academic publisher based in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada, operating a comprehensive journal platform with multiple specialized peer-reviewed publications. All journals are published under Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial 4.0 licenses, ensuring open access to research.

## Psychology & Counseling Journals

- [Journal of Assessment and Research in Applied Counseling (JARAC)](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/jarac): JARAC - open-access counseling research journal by KMANPUB

- [Psychology of Woman Journal](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/psywoman): Psychology of Woman Journal - open-access women's psychology research
- [Psychology of Woman Vol. 7 No. 1 (2026)](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/psywoman/issue/current): Current issue (Vol. 7 No. 1 2026) of Psychology of Woman Journal
- [Journal of Personality and Psychosomatic Research (JPPR)](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/jppr): JPPR - open-access journal for personality and psychosomatic research
- [JPPR Vol. 4 No. 1 (2026)](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/jppr/issue/current): Current issue (Vol. 4 No. 1 2026) of JPPR journal
- [KMAN Counseling & Psychology Nexus](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/psychnexus): KMAN Counseling & Psychology Nexus - open-access counseling journal
- [KMAN Counseling & Psychology Nexus Vol. 4 (2026)](https://journals.kmanpub.com/index.php/psychnexus/issue/current): Current issue (Vol. 4 2026) of KMAN Counseling & Psychology Nexus
